confirmedFindings.title: Strict UUID Tenant ID Rejects Numeric PBX Tenant Identifiers
confirmedFindings.body: Enforcing strict UUIDv4 validation rejects legitimate PBX tenant identifiers (such as 'tenant_1001' or integer IDs) produced by pbx_device_manager, causing 100% of non-UUID tenant CDRs to be silently rejected and unbilled.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Support both UUID and alphanumeric legacy tenant ID formats: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/.
